The '''Outland Clan''' were a clan of [[S'kytri]] consisting of those who embraced life as "walkers", as well as those who were [[Reproduction|born]] with deformities and reverse-[[Color|pigmentation]] but had gone undestroyed upon [[Egg/Legends|hatching]]. They made up a third of the S'kytri population on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Skye/Legends|Skye]]. Long before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Outland Clanners served as the [[Lowland Clans|Lowlanders]]' serfs, etching a niche [[Farm/Legends|farming]] the arable land among Skye's [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]]. Later, the other clans ended up allowing the Oulanders to live in defiance of the sacred laws in exchange for the [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] they produced. The three clans lived in relative peace due to their economic dependency on each other until the [[Geneticist/Legends|genetic]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Zeta Magnus]] turned the Outland Clanners against the other S'kytri. After seducing the Outlanders with the promise that he could increase their agricultural productivity and reverse their pigmentation with advanced sciences, he infected them with a plague that turned them into [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]]-like creatures. With the Outlanders under his control, Zeta Magnus used them to build his [[Kharys' fortress|fortress]] on Skye and dispatched them on suicide raids against the citadels of the Lowland and [[Highland Clans]]. After Republic forces arrived to apprehend the terrorist, the S'kytri fought the Outlanders in a brutal [[Battle of Skye|battle]].<ref name="swcw" />
